system_thesis_interpretation: This is a finite, single-pair engineering-ceiling organism rather than a general learning system. The host first freezes a public typed account of each life and keeps raw events, private truth, score, answers, audit prose, and branch identity outside cognition. Each public event becomes a durable witnessed declarative row. A frozen 32B controller may repeatedly propose local typed joins, but those proposals remain audit-only unless one blind same-model reflection structurally supports them; support is a fallible admission predicate rather than semantic truth. The later final resolver starts with no raw life, no prior THINK0 state, and only atomic semantic reads. Its temporary scratch is discarded at trace end. Only after a reviewed text pass, exactly two independent 7B rank-64 adapters encode the already sealed per-life M1_OWN semantic corpus for candidate-constrained atomic recognition; they are not a shared or persistent controller. Thus the enduring state is immutable life-local row memory, then conditionally an isolated life-local adapter; transient state is request/scratch state; and outcome truth remains offline-only. The proposed signal is whether target-absent local construction can supply later goal-directed path material, not whether the system discovers the world autonomously or learns a reusable policy.
graph_delta_interpretation: P1CC_PUBLIC_PROJECTOR converts the frozen v03r event stream into host-only E audit objects and single witnessed M rows before each WAKE, separating evidence ownership from model-visible row aliases. P1CC_PROPOSAL_ADMISSION makes DREAM a write proposal interface: CREATE reserves one immutable proposal owner, SELF_CHECK consumes exactly one eligible dispatch opportunity, and only structurally SUPPORTED creates a new immutable cognitive row. Because lineage, citations, depth, duplicate ownership, and conflict are reducer outputs, breadth-like growth is a bounded directed citation graph, not free-form dialogue memory. P1CC_RECURRENT_CONSTRUCTOR schedules which existing canonical rows are exposed to local proposal work and forks M0 into independently evolving OWN and DIST branches without cross-branch reads. P1CC_ATOMIC_RESOLVER converts either text lookup or adapter-selected completion into the same H-handle projection, putting all goal-directed traversal and composition in the THINK model's bounded scratch rather than the host. P1CC_PROSPECTIVE_INTERVENTIONS freezes pre-goal DIST and post-goal reader plans before output, so their paths control availability rather than retrospectively explaining success. P1CC_MEMORY_LORA_TRANSPORT compiles only sealed M1_OWN semantic rows into four views and makes the adapter an alternate recognition backend, never a provenance channel. P1CC_MONOTONE_AUTHORITY is a separate governance graph: immutable packets and role-separated dispositions, not a successful model trace, issue the only successor authority token. No thinker outcome becomes new dream evidence in this change: all held-out model traces seal before offline scoring, and the experiment terminates rather than feeding results back into recurrence.
loop_delta_interpretation: The prefix is an explicitly bounded construction loop: 46 public WAKE triggers interleaved with 22 REACTIVATE calls and followed by 16 SLEEP calls, for 84 proposal slots per life. Each selected trigger exposes at most five neighbors, selector counts advance only after a state seals, and every valid novel proposal gets at most one reflection; malformed, duplicate, contradicted, unresolved, and unsupported paths add audit receipts but no cognitive state. This supports limited local connection growth across rows, including multi-hop citations, while retaining false supported rows and forbidding outcome repair. THINK0 is a target-absent, at-most-12-operation probe which either produces the registered return focus or DEFER; its focus is a treatment selector, not memory evidence. M0 performs no return dreaming. OWN and pre-sealed public DIST then each receive the same sixteen slot/seed envelope but evolve branch-local rows, yielding the fixed M1_OWN corpus before the final goal is used. THINK1 is a separate at-most-12-operation goal-directed loop: one atomic read result at a time can be placed in scratch and only an ancestral, later-cited handle can count as structural use at COMMIT. Every early terminal leaves later opportunities as non-dispatch ledger rows, so no retry or hidden call changes the budget. DEV has 216 controller opportunities; held-out text has at most 632; conditional transport adds exactly two fits, 96 fidelity cases, at most 48 recognition reads, and at most 48 controller operations, for an 896-call ceiling. No outer learning loop, policy adaptation, corpus revision, refit, or continuation survives the terminal human boundary.
claim_delta_interpretation: A text green result would only establish the registered conjunction on one aligned seed-5 twin pair: a game-specific ontology/proof-scaffolded frozen resolver used life-bound, offline-correct role and causal rows through the specified return-feedback and intervention pattern. Return credit is stronger than final success because it additionally requires non-NO_FOCUS returns, own-only focus-matching causal rows, M0 and DIST losses, donor behavior, path loss, sham retention, and nondecorative ancestral citations. A LoRA green result is still narrower: two isolated fixed-corpus adapters recognized registered candidates from the shared roster and supplied the same semantic read contract along the registered own/donor paths. It is not open recall, whole-corpus storage, durability, capacity, scale, or superiority. The frozen Paper-1 headline remains unestablished: there is no replication, baseline comparison, learned LOOP policy, rank/lifetime scaling, autonomous discovery, base promotion, or outcome-trained credit assignment. Review and schema artifacts establish process conformance only; they do not convert the canary into scientific authorization.
visibility_matrix_interpretation: The matrix implements a one-way evidence boundary. DREAM can see selected canonical M rows but neither raw E objects nor audit/selector material, focus, final goal, donor, private truth, or result. SELF_CHECK sees only the proposed semantic tuple, ordered premises, and registered additional rows, so its prose/confidence cannot create a feedback channel. THINK0 sees a public non-answer probe and provenance-free M0 reads and can emit but not consume a return focus. RETURN_DREAM may receive that registered focus or public DIST as a non-evidentiary selector hint while final-goal and score remain embargoed. Compilation sees only the sealed eligible M1_OWN semantics; focus, donor, audit, and outcome cannot become training text. THINK1 sees the final public question plus one H projection at a time, never row IDs, citations, depth, backend identity, raw life, or audit stream. OFFLINE_EVAL alone reunites handles with rows, private truth, branch ownership, and results after all affected traces seal. This makes declarative rows and adapter weights durable but keeps their provenance and the scoring oracle out of the resolver's working state.
acceptance_test_interpretation: P1CB01_SCOPE_HASH_RUNTIME_AND_MONOTONE_AUTHORITY measures whether the governance graph, bound bytes, CPU preflight position, and monotone stage order prevent unauthorized continuation; it does not establish model behavior. P1CB02_FINAL_REQUEST_AND_DURABLE_STATE_TAINT_NONINTERFERENCE tests the crucial information-flow claim that forbidden host/audit/private fields cannot alter later requests, row semantics, views, candidates, or read projections, while allowing only the declared focus treatment. P1CB03_CLOSED_ROWS_REFLECTION_REDUCER_AND_PROVENANCE tests the declarative-store reducer: immutable witness/support ownership, hashes, lineage, cycles, duplicates, and conflicts, but deliberately cannot measure semantic correctness. P1CB04_CANONICAL_CORPUS_ATOMIC_READER_AND_MATCHED_MOUNTS tests equivalence of semantic sources and provenance-free reader shape across text and adapter backends, including mount isolation; it is not a test that the adapter has learned arbitrary recall. P1CB05_IMMUTABLE_SHORTCUT_AND_THREE_ARM_DEV_HEADROOM tests that frozen fixture pathways contain usable nonshortcut headroom and that the thinker/parser can exploit G rows, but DEV gold does not validate held-out construction. P1CB06_EXACT_RECURRENT_SCHEDULE_ZERO_RETURN_AND_MATCHED_BRANCHES tests the mechanically unique treatment: schedule, seeds, state sealing, M0 zero return, and independently matched branches, which is necessary for interpreting later interventions. P1CB07_FIXED_M1_TEXT_AND_PROSPECTIVE_READER_INTERVENTIONS tests the complete held-out text causal-use conjunction only when plans and controls were sealed before traces; its losses and structural-use requirements link M1_OWN content to the committed result but remain one-pair evidence. P1CB08_TWO_LOCKED_ADAPTERS_PER_LIFE_FIDELITY_AND_SWAP tests conditional parametric transport and own/donor mount behavior after text success, with separate fidelity gates preventing pooled credit. P1CB09_TRANSITION_LOCAL_RUNTIME_ACCOUNTING_AND_VALIDITY tests that every dispatch, non-dispatch, failure, fit, and transition has exactly one allowed ledger/validity route, preserving denominator and compute integrity. P1CB10_INDEPENDENT_STAGE_REVIEW_CLAIM_FIREWALL_AND_HUMAN_STOP tests process separation and terminal claim limits; it cannot prove substantive reviewer independence beyond the platform attestations it validates.
assumptions: The public projection and all frozen vector receipts can be implemented without exposing withheld final-answer semantics to a held-out provider.
The shared candidate roster is sealed before adapter scoring and candidate-to-semantic lookup occurs only after selection, so it cannot act as a host answer channel.
Branch-local copy-on-write identity and handle-to-row joins are preserved in offline artifacts even though thinker-visible projections omit origin and provenance.
A structural-use check over retained scratch can determine causal ancestry to COMMIT without interpreting model prose as evidence.
Platform attestations are accepted only as the stated operational evidence of fresh role separation, not as cryptographic proof of independence.

ambiguities.question: When no legal matched sham exists, is the aggregate held-out stage a valid scientific failure, as the resolution brief and experiment specification state, or an invalid precondition, as the acceptance registry's P1CB07 expected text states?
ambiguities.impact: The two outcomes have different authority/claim routing. Because the normative package declares contradictions invalid preconditions, an implementation cannot select either reading without a repaired bound protocol.

ambiguities.question: The proposal says all listed v1c files are jointly normative, while several state/schema resources express local grammar rather than an explicit cross-contract precedence rule; where should an implementation record semantic cross-file consistency beyond hash equality?
ambiguities.impact: A field-valid object can still violate a different normative contract; P1CB01 and P1CB09 need a precise executable contradiction inventory to fail closed.

disagreements_with_proposal.statement: The proposal's otherwise strong fail-closed design is internally inconsistent about the validity class of sham infeasibility.
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: The resolution brief and experiment specification call unidentifiable sham a sealed valid negative/stage failure while the acceptance registry calls sham infeasibility an invalid precondition. These are materially different state-machine outcomes, and the experiment specification itself forbids choosing a preferred normative reading.
disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: Before ratification, issue a new hash-bound repair that assigns one validity/reason pair and conforming wording to every contract, acceptance test, review packet, and authority transition; until then route the contradiction as INVALID_PRECONDITION/PROTOCOL_CONTRADICTION.

disagreements_with_proposal.statement: The review gate should be described as an operational separation control, not evidence that human/model reviewer independence has been proved.
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: The design itself says platform identity and fresh-context receipts are bindings rather than cryptographic proof; schema-valid two-approval artifacts can establish required workflow compliance but not the stronger social fact.
disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: Keep the gate exactly as an authorization requirement and keep reports explicit that its evidence is platform-attested role separation only.

open_questions: Does Rohin ratify the exact repaired protocol bytes and scope only after the sham-infeasibility routing contradiction is resolved in a new bound proposal?
If ratified, does Rohin authorize only CPU implementation and CPU preflight, with DEV, held-out text, conditional LoRA, claims, and all external actions still requiring their stated successor gates?
